text: I need to check for signs of infection or metabolic imbalance immediately. REQUEST TEST: CBC, CMP, Blood_Culture, CT_Head

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal CT and basic labs make infection or acute stroke less likely, but the smoking history and age raise concern for a small cell lung cancer causing paraneoplastic encephalitis or SIADH. speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated urine osmolality and sodium in the setting of hyponatremia confirm euvolemic hyponatremia consistent with SIADH. I will now request imaging to look for the underlying cause, likely a lung malignancy given the smoking history. REQUEST IMAGES
